description:
The HR department needs help fixing a presentation. Slide 2 contains a raw full-screen screenshot of the new Employee Portal, but it looks unprofessional because the browser address bar (top) and system taskbar (bottom) are visible.

Your task:
1. Open Slide 2 of the loaded presentation 'HR_Portal_Guide.odp'.
2. CROP the screenshot image to hide the top browser bar (approx 1.5-3cm) and the bottom taskbar (approx 0.5-1.5cm).
3. Add a visible BLUE border (solid line, approx 2pt width) to the image to define its edges against the white slide.
4. Save the presentation (Ctrl+S).
